description: This file defines an enum ErrorMessage containing various string constants for error messages related to registration and server errors.

ctags.name: GenericFail
ctags.pattern: /^  GenericFail = 'A server error occurred. Please try again.',$/

ctags.name: GenericInProgress
ctags.pattern: /^  GenericInProgress = 'An existing request is already in progress.',$/

ctags.name: GenericRegistrationFail
ctags.pattern: /^  GenericRegistrationFail = 'A server error occurred while trying to register. Please try again./

ctags.name: InsufficientPasswordMessage
ctags.pattern: /^  InsufficientPasswordMessage = 'Your password must be at least %LENGTH% characters in length. F/

ctags.name: PasscodeRequired
ctags.pattern: /^  PasscodeRequired = 'Your passcode is required in order to register for an account.',$/

ctags.name: RateLimited
ctags.pattern: /^  RateLimited = 'Too many successive server requests. Please wait a few minutes and try again.',$/

ctags.name: RegistrationInProgress
ctags.pattern: /^  RegistrationInProgress = 'An existing registration request is already in progress.',$/
